messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for Collier Row & Havering RBL?
messages.body:
Hi,

Just following up on my note about Jake Essex for Collier Row & Havering RBL. Jake is a high-energy 50s and 60s rock and roll singer, himself, not a tribute, with his own PA and no deposit needed.

For clubs like yours it's from £250 for two one hour sets. If you have any dates in the diary for the months ahead, I'd love to pencil something in, or just point me to whoever looks after entertainment.

If it's not for you, just reply "no thanks" and I won't email again.

Best,
Natalie
Bookings for Jake Essex
www.jakeessex.co.uk
